entries.finding: Heller et al. 2019 (2019A&A...627A..66H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HELLER_ET_AL__2019): P 28.1656 d; Kruse et al. 2019 (2019ApJS..244...11K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KRUSE_ET_AL__2019): a/R* 61.5; Heller et al. 2019 (2019A&A...627A..66H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HELLER_ET_AL__2019): inclination derived from its impact parameter 0.24 with the orbit's a/R* 61.5 (Winn 2010, eq. 7); No archive row states an eccentricity; the orbit is taken as circular; Heller et al. 2019 (2019A&A...627A..66H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HELLER_ET_AL__2019): transit mid-time 2456852.6572 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 579 min); Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north)..
